title.narrative: Emergency WASH and health response for flood affected population of Freetown (Western Area) Sierra L

description.narrative:
Heavy rains in Freetown on the 14th August 2017 have caused a mud/landslide in Regent, Western Rural district and, a suburb of Freetown. The number of fatalities is still unknown, but according to the Red Cross (14/08/2017) over 312 bodies have been brought to the city mortuary. The government of Sierra Leone is currently undertaking a search and rescue operation, and expects the number of casualities to increase significantly.
1) Health and hygiene campaign: Health and hygiene messaging will directly target 1,000 affected households, i.e. 5,000 persons. Through activities such as radio messaging, door-to-door visits, posters and street theatre, information will effectively be disseminated to the entire community, the estimated number of indirect beneficiaries is expected to be around 10,000 persons. During the door-to-door visits, handwashing soap and water treatment sachets will be handed out and explained to 1,000 affected and vulnerable households. socio-economic status, or any other factors.
